sources.title: Trivy vulnerability scanning
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Kubernetes Pod Security：限制政策與例外生命週期
related.titleEn: Kubernetes Pod Security: restricted policies and expiring exceptions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付30筆分流表、映像摘要、資料庫時間、修復試驗及殘餘風險清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver thirty triage rows, image digest, database date, remediation trials and residual-risk list.
related.difference: 逐項檢查特權、使用者、能力與檔案系統要求，分開標準必需條件及本組織額外政策。
related.differenceEn: Check privilege, users, capabilities and filesystem requirements, distinguishing standard requirements from additional local policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可立即修復比例=有可用相容修復的唯一發現/需處理發現；不代表修復後零風險。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 報告有30筆去重後需處理發現，18筆有修復版本，12筆暫無；其中6筆修復仍需相容性驗證。 有版本可修復比例18/30=60%；已確認可採用的修復只有12/30=40%。
合規比例=通過所選政策的工作負載/適用工作負載；額外唯讀要求不能誤稱為全部標準的必需條件。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個工作負載中9個通過指定Restricted版本與本地附加政策，3個有明確缺口。 初始通過率9/12=75%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Immediately fixable fraction counts unique actionable findings with compatible fixes; it does not imply zero residual risk. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Thirty unique actionable findings include eighteen with fixes and twelve without; six available fixes still need compatibility validation. Fix availability is 60%, but confirmed adoptable fixes are only 12/30=40%.

Compliance is workloads passing the selected policy divided by applicable workloads; extra read-only rules must not be mislabeled as universal standard requirements. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Nine of twelve workloads pass the pinned Restricted version and local additions; three have identified gaps. Initial pass rate=9/12=75%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Azure Policy：範圍、豁免與到期治理
related.titleEn: Azure Policy: scope, exemptions and expiry governance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付30筆分流表、映像摘要、資料庫時間、修復試驗及殘餘風險清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver thirty triage rows, image digest, database date, remediation trials and residual-risk list.
related.difference: 記錄政策指派範圍、豁免類型、理由與期限；讓儀表板分開呈現真正符合與被豁免。
related.differenceEn: Record assignment scope, exemption category, reason and expiry; report actual compliance separately from exemptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可立即修復比例=有可用相容修復的唯一發現/需處理發現；不代表修復後零風險。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 報告有30筆去重後需處理發現，18筆有修復版本，12筆暫無；其中6筆修復仍需相容性驗證。 有版本可修復比例18/30=60%；已確認可採用的修復只有12/30=40%。
真實符合率=符合資源/適用資源；豁免率另算，不把豁免自動變成控制已實作。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 40個適用資源中30個符合、6個有效豁免、4個不符合。 符合率30/40=75%，豁免率6/40=15%，未符合且未豁免10%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Immediately fixable fraction counts unique actionable findings with compatible fixes; it does not imply zero residual risk. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Thirty unique actionable findings include eighteen with fixes and twelve without; six available fixes still need compatibility validation. Fix availability is 60%, but confirmed adoptable fixes are only 12/30=40%.

Actual conformity is compliant resources divided by applicable resources; exemptions do not mean the control is implemented. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Forty applicable resources include thirty compliant, six valid exemptions and four noncompliant. Conformity is 75%, exemptions 15%, and noncompliant unexempted resources 10%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
